title: The Fisher card and Red Long's New Orleans Swing Band
summary: He says the word jazz was on Fisher's 1911 card and that he played in Red Long's New Orleans Swing Band at the Ritz decades before Goodman.

bands.name: Red Long's New Orleans Swing Band

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: No, no. If I said so, I'd be lying, Dick. I don't. This all of a sudden there it was. But even before, you know, I was a kid. But even before, I can go back this far, but even before they ever had jazz bands at all, ragtime bands or whatever you want to call them. You see, like I tell you, I had a card here of Fisher's Band where it was printed on it, Fisher's Ragtime Military Jazz Band. Now that's, when I first played, I was eight years old, that first job, the first parade I ever played. Now if I was born in 1903, that was in 1911. And the word jazz, they used it on that, on that chord. And the word swing, were used a whole lot sooner than 1934 because I played with a band, a piano player by the name of Red Long. And we had a band in the, used to be the, you know where that Dime Dance Hall was on Iberville Street there? Well, that originally was the Pup in the days of the Red Light. That was the Pup. And then they changed it to the Oasis. And then it later became the Ritz. Well, Rapolo and, and, and, and Skag Leone, those guys played in it when it was the Oasis. And then we went in, they called it the Ritz. And the band was, uh, Red Long, Chink, Angelo Palmasana, on the banjo. Joe Law, Joe Law, Canada guy that's got the, the hot dog wagons, on saxophone, and myself. And, uh, the name of that band was, Glenn Lee Long, and his New Orleans Swing Band. Now that's, that's, that's, that's 20 years before Goodman and those guys ever come out with, with swing goods.
This Fisher card. They used to call it Swing. This Fisher card, they'll call it Ragtime, not Jazz. Is that right? Huh? The Fisher, you mentioned Fisher.

No, they call it, they call it all. The, the, the, the card would, would read, Fisher's Ragtime Military Jazz Band. Jazz Band was on the, uh, Now, uh, which, uh, what's her name? Helen Alt. Yeah. Is a, is a relative of Fisher's. Yeah. He's her uncle or, something like that.
